subject.title: fix(agents-bind): generate peer format for feishu group bindings

question: What permanent Feishu bind grammar should OpenClaw support for conversation peers without breaking documented account bindings?
rationale: The observable bug needs peer-shaped Feishu conversation bindings, but this PR changes a public CLI/config contract and competes with other open candidate syntaxes, so maintainers need to choose the compatibility shape before merge.

options.title: Preserve account syntax and add a safe peer path
options.body: Keep existing channel/account semantics and add either explicit peer syntax or plugin-owned Feishu conversation recognition with account escape, docs, and tests.

options.title: Choose a sibling candidate after syntax review
options.body: Pause this PR and adopt another open candidate only if it better matches the chosen grammar and becomes clean, proven, and mergeable.

options.title: Retarget or close this branch
options.body: If the branch is not worth salvaging because of mixed scopes and compatibility churn, leave the canonical issue open for a focused replacement PR.

recommendation.title: Preserve account syntax and add a safe peer path
recommendation.body: Keep existing channel/account semantics and add either explicit peer syntax or plugin-owned Feishu conversation recognition with account escape, docs, and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: gumadeiras introduced the account-scoped bind command surface that any compatible grammar change must preserve or intentionally evolve.
